title: Compose a dependency-correct workflow
prompt:
An authorized local report must validate a CSV before transforming it and verify the output after writing it. Steps available: read_csv, validate_rows, transform_rows, write_report, verify_report. Arrange all steps in execution order.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. steps: ordered array of all step names.
remediation_hints: Check inputs before work, and verify the artifact after writing it.
